title: go-envelopes Manifest
description: Defines core envelope types for Go validation and TypeScript codegen. Runtime envelope instances carry additional fields not modeled here (presentation, trace, etc.) — see types.go for the Envelope struct and docs/manifest-spec.md for the full manifest contract. Host-specific routing fields (e.g. drawer/panel ids) belong on each host's own wrapper struct, not in go-envelopes.

component.description: Host component path preserved by the Go registry/catalog and emitted as import metadata by the module-owned TypeScript generator.

export.description: Named export from the component module, preserved by the Go registry/catalog and emitted as import metadata by the module-owned TypeScript generator.

props.description: Optional host-defined prop discriminator (e.g. 'approval', 'proposal'), preserved by the Go registry/catalog and emitted as import metadata by the module-owned TypeScript generator.
